_doc: Reusable audio-preservation smoke payload (1-scene, clip + voiceover).
Activates the dual-track contract from enqueue/narrated_clip_timeline.go:
the worker emits audio_tracks[] with BOTH role:voiceover AND role:scene_clip_audio
lanes when a scene has explicit voiceover_duration_seconds + final_clip_duration_seconds
(or the worker probes them via sharedmedia.DetectAudioDurationSecs).
The clip's original audio is preserved AFTER the voiceover bed at offsetSeconds=0
and runs for final_clip_duration_seconds; the C++ engine's muxAudio merges both
Assets reused from tests/worker-cert/fixtures/assets.json (DO NOT add new
asset_id rows here): voiceover asset-recording-001, clip opening-clip-01.
Substituted at submit time by run.sh --mode=submit: idempotency_key,
Redundant legacy per-binding upload-target fields are intentionally
omitted; the master derives the uplink from the velox-asset:// scheme
video_name: Audio preservation smoke (1 scene, clip + voiceover both audible)

scenes.text: Una scena con audio della clip preservato insieme al voiceover sovrapposto.
